scoring_justification: Recompute (T1) is infeasible because the checker would need to run an RCWA simulation. Structural ordering check for reflectance is feasible and efficiency is compared to the paper-reported reference.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'InGaAs is showing the highest efficiency of 87.45%'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: It is the actual result reported in the paper, serving as hidden reference.

outputs.description: Reflectance vs. angle for four materials. The checker verifies the physically expected ordering of reflectance values among materials.
Absolute diffraction efficiency into the -1st order for InGaAs grating at the optimal angle, compared to a hidden reference value.

output_contract.notes: The solver should use sufficient Fourier orders and periodic boundary conditions. The optimum angle is expected around 47° but must be determined from step_01 results.
